title.en: Keep Electric Low Pressure 40 Concrete Pump as printed while Crossflow cylinder head only supplies the map
title.zh: 电动低压40型混凝土泵照印，Crossflow cylinder head只当路线图

description.en: The Electric Low Pressure 40 Concrete Pump note follows the outline of Crossflow cylinder head. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Electric Low Pressure 40 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Motor Power 37 kW; Output Capacity 12–15 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.3 m³; Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 80 m / 240 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112; Dimensions (L×W×H) 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm; Main Unit Weight 1200 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 电动低压40型混凝土泵这篇笔记顺着《Crossflow cylinder head》的大纲写。邢台河北品锦机械公布电动低压40型混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：电机功率37 kW；理论输送量12–15 m³/h；最大出口压力20 MPa；料斗容积0.3 m³；细石输送（水平/垂直）80 m / 240 m；液压泵Kawasaki 112；外形尺寸3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm；整机重量1200 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
